01.text: A reelplanner video doesn't have to send you to a browser. With the plugin installed, /reel plays it in a pane right beside your conversation with Claude.
01.said: A reel planner video doesn't have to send you to a browser. With the plugin installed, slash reel plays it in a pane right beside your conversation with Claude.

02.text: Type /reel to list the plans that have a video, newest first, with their open choices. Pick one, or name it, and it starts playing at once.
02.said: Type slash reel to list the plans that have a video, newest first, with their open choices. Pick one, or name it, and it starts playing at once.

03.text: At each open choice the video stops. The question and its options sit under the picture, with the recommended one marked. Press a number to answer, m to leave a comment at that moment, and n or b to jump between stops.

04.text: The last stop sums up your review. Send it. Approve, and Claude builds the plan. Ask for changes, and Claude revises it, and the pane plays just what changed.

05.text: In kitty or Ghostty the picture plays right in the terminal. Anywhere else, the pane opens the browser player and keeps the choices, comments and Send.
